origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : à gauche 扌, la main. À droite 广, vaste, qui se lit guǎng et ne donne pas le son de kuò. La main qui rend plus vaste : élargir, agrandir.
origine_en: As a memory aid: on the left is 扌, the hand. On the right is 广, wide, read guǎng, which does not give the sound of kuò. The hand that makes something wider: to expand, to enlarge.
